y-m-12-01.material: UMinjae ulinganisa ubukhulu be-engile ㅅㅇㅈ (시옷 이응 지읒), ezotyiweyo ephepheni, nge-protractor. Walungelelanisa ububanzi be-protractor nencopho ㅇ, waza walungelelanisa icala ㅇㅅ nempawu ye-0° ekunene kwe-protractor. Ejonga apho icala ㅇㅈ lidlula khona, iimpawu zinokufundwa kwimigca emibini. Ukufunda umgca oqala kwi-0° yasekunene kunika u-65, yaye ukufunda umgca oqala kwi-0° yasekhohlo kunika u-115. Le engile ibonakala incinci kune-engile ethe nkqo (ikona ethe nkqo yesetsikwere). Umfanekiso awubonakaliswa, ngoko cinga iindawo ezichazwe ngamazwi.

y-m-12-12.s.s1.explain: Akukho kuqinisekiswa ukuba owokuqala kwiklasi nganye ulingana nowokuqala kwitheyibhile edityanisiweyo. Unokukhangela ngokwenene wenza amanani enza i-dodgeball ibe yeyokuqala.
y-m-12-12.s.s2.prompt: Vumela amanani abantu bebhola ekhatywayo, ibhola yomnyazi, ne-dodgeball kwiKlasi 가 abe yi-a1, a2, a3, kwaye kwiKlasi 나 abe yi-b1, b2, b3. Yenza iitheyibhile ezi-2 ezahlukeneyo apho i-dodgeball ikwindawo yokuqala xa iiklasi zombini zidityanisiwe. Iklasi nganye inabantu abangama-20 zizonke, kwaye iKlasi 가 kufuneka ibe nebhola ekhatywayo ngokucacileyo ngaphezu kwezinye ezimbini, kwaye iKlasi 나 kufuneka ibe nebhola yomnyazi ngokucacileyo ngaphezu kwezinye ezimbini. Kwitheyibhile edityanisiweyo, i-dodgeball nayo kufuneka ibe ngokucacileyo ngaphezu kwezinye ezimbini.

y-m-12-12.s.s3.prompt: Esi siphumo sikuxelela ntoni ngengcinga ethi 'ukuba uyazi owokuqala kwiklasi nganye, ungamazi owokuqala kwibanga lonke'? Bhala nolunye ulwazi olufunekayo ukuze wazi owokuqala kwibanga lonke.
